name: Google Antigravity
description: Google's agent-first AI IDE and agentic development platform that coordinates multiple AI agents across editor, terminal, and browser. Features autonomous development with R.A.P.S Framework for parallel agent management and deep Google Cloud integration.
community_quotes: Agent-first approach with multi-agent coordination system
Direct competitor to Cursor and Windsurf with parallel agents
Featured prominently at Google I/O 2026 as part of the 'agentic era'
